note: Private campground at 16612 County Road R, Maribel, on the Devils River by the historic 1847 Rock Mill and its falls. Mostly seasonal: about 26 of its 132 sites are sold by the night. Swimming pond and pool. Phone reservations; the operator's site posts only a phone number and a 2013 site map. --Claude
summary: Operator site (phone + location only), its 2013 map, Good Sam directory, Google and imagery read. Mostly seasonal: Good Sam lists 106 extended-stay of 132 sites, 26 for travelers (~20%). Fees $34-40, 132 sites, 30 amp + water, season May 1 - Oct 5 written as reported (Good Sam). Riverfront not supported: narrow stream under canopy, river-side sites look seasonal -> not waterfront (creekside at most). Possible drop candidate (mostly seasonal + iffy).
flags: POSSIBLE DROP CANDIDATE (mostly seasonal AND iffy): Good Sam directory lists 'numexstaysites 106' of 'totalsites 132', with 'spacesavailable 26' (about 20% nightly, so test 4 passes and a kept entry carries the 'Mostly seasonal' line). Iffy because the operator's own site gives only a phone number and a 2013 map: no rate, no site count, no season; the only rate is Good Sam's $34-40 marked 'Phone Update' with 2024 season dates. Good Sam also tags the park under 'Campgrounds with lots or park models for sale' (generic category link; not confirmed on any operator page). Google 4.6 (295) is a strong, campground-only rating. Price passes ($34-40). Reviewer decides.

WATERFRONT: stored riverfront -> not waterfront (creekside at most). The Devils River here is a narrow stream (~10 m channel on imagery, widening to ~25-30 m only in the mill pool above the falls at about 44.3005,-87.7783), so riverfront fails the 30 m size test. The 2013 map puts sites 39-56 along the river and 84-85 by the falls; imagery shows a row of trailers about 20-25 m above the mill pool over grass at about 44.3007,-87.7790, but they look like long-standing seasonal units and no page says which river sites are sold by the night; elsewhere the river is under continuous canopy. Default down. Suggested waterfront_evidence: 'Operator 2013 map + Esri/NAIP 2026-11-16: Devils River ~10 m wide (mill pool ~25-30 m); river-side sites 39-56 look seasonal, nightly use unconfirmed -> not waterfront'. If the operator confirms nightly sites on the river row, creekside.
